_comment: Merge these keys into Jarvis's existing config.json -- do not replace the whole file. Unlisted keys (db_path, active_profiles, tts_*, wake_word, whisper_model) stay as they are. Confirmed against isair/jarvis settings_window.py: the top-level key is 'mcps', not 'mcp_servers'.
_comment_models: Only needed if you route Jarvis through ollama_glm_proxy.py. Point ollama_base_url at the proxy (11435); it forwards embeddings to real Ollama on 11434. Jarvis uses THREE separate model settings -- all must match whatever GLM_MODEL you launch the proxy with. Omit this whole block to keep Jarvis on its own local Ollama models.
